Introduction

Home Introduction
--
Introduction

Corporate Institute of Science and Technology (CIST) is situated in the capital of Madhya Pradesh, Bhopal. Bhopal is famous for it’s scenic beauty and diverse culture. Also, it has developed into an important education centre of Central India.

CIST, which operates under the aegis of Essarjee Education Society, came into existence through a noble thought of our founder patron Er. G.C. Shah, who believes education to be a tool to develop our greatest abilities and that a nation’s progress is as swift as the progress it makes in education. The institute runs courses approved by AICTE, Department of Technical Education –Govt. of M.P. and is affiliated to Rajiv Gandhi Praudyogiki Vishwavidhyalaya , Bhopal. U.G. courses are available in Civil , Computer Science ,CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning), Electronics and Communication , Electrical and Electronics and Mechanical Engineering. Post Graduate courses are available in Mechanical (Thermal Systems) and Electrical & Electronics (Power Systems).

CIST is situated in a beautifully landscaped campus at Hathaikheda, near Patel Nagar Bhopal and provides an ideal environment for quality teaching – learning through state of art lecture theatres, fully equipped laboratories and workshops, highly qualified faculty including guest faculty from industry, well equipped gymnasium with trainer and huge playgrounds. Emphasis is on developing engineering as well as life skills to make our students ready for further higher education and to increase their employability.

Hostel facilities are provided for boys and girls. Boys hostels are situated on the college campus whereas the girls hostels are situated in a prime city location near Habibganj Railway station. Bus facility is available from all parts of the city to the campus.

Home Introduction
--
Introduction

The MBA Department was started in the year 2017 at Corporate Institute of Management (CIM), Bhopal with a vision to produce efficient management professionals. Life at CIM is a journey through education, sprinkled with a variety of academic and non-academic learning that goes beyond the conventional classroom method and a pedagogy that fully equips the student with the necessary tools to become a leader. The entire learning process is focused on inculcating team-spirit in participants, sensitivity to real-world issues and an ability to become leaders in their chosen fields. The MBA Department is equipped with advanced Infrastructure, Computer Lab, library, providing latest e-services, classrooms and Seminar hall with LCD Projectors, Audio-Visual (Multimedia) hall with videoconferencing facilities.

Master of Business Administration (MBA) is a 2 year full time program, approved by AICTE and affiliated to Barkatullah University, Bhopal. The department is committed to groom future managers to meet evolving needs of the Industry. The department has highly qualified, dedicated and experienced faculty with corporate and international exposures. The students are trained by rich pool of corporate trainers . Pedagogy includes entrepreneurship development cell activities, Industrial tours, as well as regular interface with industry experts through guest lectures and workshops.

DEPARTMENT OF MANAGEMENT (MBA)

Corporate Institute of Science & Technology is a premier institution for the Management Course in M.P. which is affiliated to Barkatullah University Bhopal MP & run full time MBA Course and General Management, focused on promoting quality education & was established in 2022.

The objective of the college is to enhance and develop competent and concurrent managers, who have knowledge of multiple disciplines, sharpened in developing general as well as specialized outlook and capability to work in domains of highly competitive world. To boost up MBA students, Strategic Curriculum has been opted which has a blend of Case based practical in each subject with combination of Theories and Numericals. All specialized & subjects of province are being tutored, like-Finance, Marketing, Human Resource Management, Retail Management, Banking, General Management. CIST offers 180 Seats in MBA Full time and 120 Seats in MBA (General Management) Course, having specialization in branches of Finance, Marketing, Human Resource Management, Retail Management, Banking, and General Management. Corporate Institute of Science & Technology has endorsed latest State of the Art Pedagogies in Training and teaching its students ranging from class room studies to outbound solutions like Industry visits, Educational tours, Conferences, Seminars, Workshops etc. The MBA Department is equipped with advanced Infrastructure, Computer Lab, library, providing latest e-services, classrooms and Seminar hall with LCD Projectors, Audio-Visual (Multimedia) hall with videoconferencing facilities.

Department of Computer Science & Engineering

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) is one of the six departments at Corporate Institute of Science and Technology, Bhopal. It administers bachelor's program in Computer Science Engineering which leads to award of B.Tech. Degree by RGPV University. It is operating since from 2008, with an intake of 120 seats. It provides a comprehensive B.Tech. program that emphasizes on Data Structures and Algorithms, Operating Systems, Database Management Systems, Computer Architecture, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Networks, Neural Networks, Information Security and high end technologies like Distributed systems, Cloud Computing, Machine Learning, Image Processing and IOT.

Facts that make us Unique
--
Our Vision

To become center of excellence by creating technologically adept graduates who possess human values and are self-motivated to serve the society with their problem-solving approach.

Our Mission
--
Focus on quality projects development using problem solving approach and team work principles.

Promote Human Values and commitment towards work ethics in students to make them valuable assets for society.

CSE department's many strengths include its high faculty-to-student ratio, well educated faculties having post graduate degrees from renowned institutes, well equipped laboratories. It provides good theoretical foundations with hands on exposure to practical tools with emphasis on leadership, service, and ethics.

Students in CSE Dept. are heavily involved in learning programming languages and developing their own projects. Industrial visits and expert lectures are conducted to ensure that students get proper mentorship from industry experts. Faculty and students often collaborate on projects for participation in National level competitions. Our students have several times brought laurels to the Department by winning in State/National level events.

Graduates from the CSE department are mostly recruited by Software Companies whereas few students take up careers in finance sector, start up companies, Banking sector, and public sector services. Some of our top undergraduates each year enter the MTech program in Computer Science and Engineering in other leading universities around the country.

Department of Mechanical Engineering

Mechanical engineering is a diverse subject that derives its area from the need to design and manufacture everything from small individual parts and devices (e.g. inkjet printer nozzles) to large systems (e.g., spacecraft and machine tools). The role of a mechanical engineer is to take a product from an idea to the marketplace. In order to accomplish this, a broad range of skills are needed. The mechanical engineer needs to acquire particular skills and knowledge. He/she needs to understand the forces and the thermal environment that a product, its parts, or its subsystems will encounter to design them for functionality, aesthetics, and the ability to withstand the forces and the thermal environment they will be subjected to and to determine the best way to manufacture them and ensure they will operate without failure.

Mechanical engineers play a central role in such industries as Automotive (from the car chassis to its every subsystem—engine, transmission, sensors); Aerospace (airplanes, aircraft engines, control systems for airplanes and spacecraft), Energy conversion (gas turbines, wind turbines, solar energy, fuel cells); Environmental control (HVAC, air-conditioning, refrigeration, compressors); Automation (robots, data and image acquisition, recognition, control); Manufacturing (machining, machine tools, prototyping, microfabrication).

Facts that make us Unique

Vision: The Mechanical Engineering Department endeavors to be recognized for outstanding education and research leading to well qualified engineers, who are innovative, entrepreneurial and successful in advanced fields of mechanical engineering to cater the ever changing industrial demands and social needs.

Our First Mission

Laboratory Facilities:

A four year Bachelor of Engineering course is offered in different branches- ME, CE, CS, EC, EX. Accordingly, the laboratories have the following purposes and goals:

- To provide an experimental foundation for the theoretical concepts introduced in the lectures. It is important that students have an opportunity to verify some of the ideas for themselves.
- To familiarize students with experimental apparatus, the scientific method, and methods of data analysis so that they will have some idea of the inductive process by which the ideas were originated. To teach how to make careful experimental observations and how to think about and draw conclusions from such data.
- To introduce the methods used for estimating and dealing with experimental uncertainties, including simple ideas in probability theory and the distinctions between random (statistical) and systematic "errors."
- To learn how to write a technical report which communicates scientific information in a clear and concise manner?
- To introduce new concepts and techniques which have a wide application in experimental science, but have not been introduced in the standard courses.

The role of a mechanical engineer is to take a product from an idea to the marketplace. In order to accomplish this, a broad range of skills are needed. The mechanical engineer needs to acquire particular skills and knowledge. He/she needs to understand the forces and the thermal environment that a product, its parts, or its subsystems will encounter to design them for functionality, aesthetics, and the ability to withstand the forces and the thermal environment they will be subjected to and to determine the best way to manufacture them and ensure they will operate without failure.
